newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Gencor mulls Brazil CVRD bid -paper.
newsitem.headline: Gencor mulls Brazil CVRD bid -paper.

text.p: Gencor Ltd is considering a bid for the mining assests of Brazil's state-run Companhia Vale do Rio Doce (CVRD), set to be privatised next year, Business Day newspaper said on Monday.
The paper quoted Gencor chairman Brian Gilbertson saying that the South African mining house was holding talks with potential Brazilian financing partners.
CVRD is the world's biggest iron ore exporter. It also has large reserves of gold and is involved in aluminium smelting, steel production and transport.
The government intends to sell a 40-45 stake and Gilbertson said Gencor's investment could be similar in size to its $1.2 billion purchase of minerals company Billiton in 1994.
He did not detail the group's financing arrangements in the event of a deal, saying only: "It is within Gencor's capacity to fund its share of the anticipated cost."
Anglo American Corp of South Africa's offshore arm Minorco has also expressed interest in CVRD. However, a Minorco spokesman told Business Day it was not considering a joint bid with Gencor.
The Brazilian government said last week that the sale of shares in CVRD would now probably take place in March, disappointing market hopes of a February start to the privatisation.
